notes.title: Demo Update - 6/27
notes.content:
[p]Thank you for playing “VanySlash”[/p][p]The following update 2025/6/27[/p][p]----------[/p][p]2025/6/27　　Version : 1.05[/p][p]・Y-axis and X-axis inversion options have been added. 
　You can access them from the in-game pause menu.[/p][p]・Added tutorial explanations. Tips will appear as you progress through the game.[/p][p]・Game balance has been adjusted.[/p][p]----------[/p][p]Thank you for your continued support of “VanySlash”.[/p][p][/p]

tags.feature:
・Y-axis and X-axis inversion options have been added.

notes.title: Demo Update - 6/16
notes.content: [p]Thank you for playing “VanySlash”[/p][p]The following update 2025/6/16[/p][p]----------[/p][p]2025/6/16[/p][list][*][p]Fixed collision issues where the player could pass through certain areas[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the player could enter a pose on the title screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where certain inputs during pause could cause the game to become unresponsive[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where money-related items could sometimes not be picked up[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the victory motion behaved unexpectedly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where accessing the options menu could prevent further progression.[/p][/*][/list][p]----------[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your continued support of “VanySlash”.[/p]

tags.bug: - Fixed collision issues where the player could pass through certain areas
- Fixed a bug where the player could enter a pose on the title screen
- Fixed an issue where certain inputs during pause could cause the game to become unresponsive
- Fixed a bug where money-related items could sometimes not be picked up
- Fixed a bug where the victory motion behaved unexpectedly
- Fixed a bug where accessing the options menu could prevent further progression.
